meta.note: Total build-out GW by resource at 2050, 7 ISO × 5 pathway × 10 endpoint. New-build gas (SPEC Card U) is an explicit resource segment — sized via worst-hour residual-gap dispatch (SPEC §24.5), not ELCC.
meta.gas_sizing_method: active_new_gas_fleet_mw read directly from the terminal row of tables.annual_buildout[].gas_sizing. The optimizer sized this to the 99.97th percentile of the margin-inclusive residual gap (SPEC §24.5 Option B-i). ELCC is NOT used.
meta.vre_to_gw_method: GW = cum_TWh / (8.76 × CF_resource) for generation. Storage GW = cum_dispatch_TWh × 1000 / representative_dispatch_hours_per_year.
